reason: The selected main calls sendToDefaultWithPanicBeforeSendInDefault, which declares a named worker and uses synchronous worker-to-default send and default-worker receive. Named workers and worker messaging, including panic propagation/interactions across workers, are not covered by the supported-feature lists. Support for panic, start and wait alone does not establish those worker semantics. The whole source also includes unsupported future cancellation.
